text:
kiran: Launch note: Conduit Lite is GA today across hosted regions (us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1). This is the lightweight streaming + toolcall profile we built for low-bandwidth clients. Docs live: https://redwood.dev/conduit-lite

kiran: Quick summary: unified run endpoint, smaller handshake for mobile, and explicit out-of-band tool results. Primary models: conduit-lite-6b, conduit-lite-12b-quant, conduit-lite-12b.

maria: New single endpoint: POST https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/conduit/run accepts sync, async, and streaming modes via the `mode` field. Tool results are returned to the `tool_results` array in the response.

kiran: Example minimal streaming curl (keepalive-friendly):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"conduit-lite-12b","mode":"stream","input":"Summarize release notes"}' \
  https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/conduit/run
```

devx-bot: note: SDK packages published: node-sdk@4.0.0, python-sdk@3.8.0, mobile-client@0.9.0 (beta). Check the SDK repo under /clients/conduit-lite.

infra: Rollout plan: staged by org over 8 hours. Were enabling prewarm for top 20 orgs and will monitor tail latencies. If you manage a high-QPS tenant, DM me for proactive capacity reservations.

ops_oncall: Prewarm kicked off in us-east at 14:12 UTC; memory and socket metrics look stable so far. Will post updates if any connection churn appears.

security: Compliance note: Conduit Lite does not change data usage policy (no training). We added HMAC v2 for streaming frames; clients must send `X-Conduit-Sig` header for signed streams. Migration guide includes example signing code.

maria: For integrators: there is a 120-day compatibility window for the legacy `/v1/generate` endpoints. New integrations should target `/v1/conduit/run`. Canary API keys are available for QA — DM me or @kiran to get temporary keys.

infra: Heads-up: add `X-Conduit-Phase: lite` to proxies and load balancers to skip the legacy frame parser. Also ensure nginx configs allow the `Connection: keep-alive` behavior for long streams.

deploy-bot: deploy: hosted/conduit-lite/gateway v1.0.1 deployed by CI at 2026-06-08T14:22:45Z 1% -> 33% roll.

kiran: Action items: devx to publish mobile examples (kotlin/swift), infra to confirm proxy header compatibility, security to verify HMAC tests in CI. Please open issues with tag `conduit-lite-ga`.

maria: Thanks team — monitoring dashboards are live in Console under Observability -> Conduit Lite. Ping in #eng-runtime for urgent regressions.

ops_oncall: :white_check_mark:
